name: variable_does_not_override_the_chamfer
why: ADVERSARIAL REVIEW OF 27/9/2026, finding 7. A dimension linked to an equation is no longer changed by set_dimension (it is driven): it is changed with global_variable — which, however, had none of the guards of set_dimension. A 120 x 80 x 20 plate with a chamfer of 2 on a long top edge, the thickness linked to «wall». Bring wall to 1: the chamfer does not fit, SOLIDWORKS rebuilds cleanly and changes the shape (the same as case r05 for set_dimension). The answer was «succeeded» and the variable stayed written. Now it is refused and the variable of before is put back; the next step proves it: the starting volume is the one with wall = 20.
defect_caught: A global variable that silently breaks a chamfer; the refusal that leaves the variable written.

expect.tolerance_why: the same: the thickness does not change

expect.why: THE REFUSAL PUT BACK wall = 20: the starting part of this step is the one from before
